text:
Sara H.: quick pre-shift check — can we confirm escalation liaisons for tonight's 18:00 UTC triage? thinking 17:45 quick sync in #eng-oncall. who can be backup for latency/cost alerts?

Eli K.: I can cover latency for the first hour. tagging Jamal for costs @Jamal R.. 17:45 SG/UTC?

Jamal R.: I’ll own cost alerts until 20:00 UTC. can someone cover model-fallback play if reclaimed GPUs happen?

Nicole (infra): I can take model-fallback for the 18:00 slot. I’ll have the rollback plan and canary keys ready. please make sure any deploys to dedicated are paused from 17:30–18:30.

Sara H.: perfect. agenda draft below — add anything else.

```
17:45 - quick rollcall (coverage + backups)
17:50 - open incidents & assignees (5m)
17:55 - active degradations + mitigations (10m)
18:05 - escalation path + pager handoff (5m)
18:10 - post-triage actions and owners
```

Jamal R.: add: validate that KV cache warmers are running (we saw a small cold-start spike last night). if canaries fail, switch routing to smaller model pool.

Sara H.: good call. adding that as 17:55 item -> "KV cache check + canary health".

oncall-bot: Incident #4521 (high latency) — acknowledged by Eli K.; last alert 11s p50, CPU 92% on gpu-pool-3. link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4521

Eli K.: I'm on it. quick ps: I pushed a small throttling change to the autoscaler in staging; will not promote until after triage.

Mari: I can join the 17:45 sync but might be 2–3 minutes late. if I miss rollcall, my backup is @Nicole (infra).

Sara H.: great — final roster: latency -> Eli K.; cost -> Jamal R.; model-fallback -> Nicole (infra); backup -> Mari. meeting in #eng-oncall at 17:45 UTC. please paste any quick runbook links or logs in-thread so we can pull into notes. :thumbsup:
